method: Computed text color, actual ancestor opacity, rendered PNG background sampled at three documented blank positions adjacent to text or inside padded surface; WCAG relative luminance formula. Gradients/translucency are read from rendered pixels, not treated as solid white.
scope: Shared header and primary navigation, new inventory success receipt, and focused AI product entry. This is a bounded sample, not a whole-site pixel audit.
